draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and proactive, ready to get things moving
notes: A conjunct verb made from 'शुरू' (beginning) and 'करना' (to do). It is transitive and takes 'ने' (ne) in the perfective.
Contrast with the intransitive 'शुरू होना' (to start by itself, e.g., फिल्म शुरू हुई — the film started).

senses.definition: To begin doing an action, task, or process.
